intent: To demonstrate that plant-based milk alternatives have a lower environmental impact in terms of emissions, land use, and water consumption compared to dairy milk.

requirements.question: Should the video explicitly show plant emissions values relative to dairy, or only state they are lower?
Should the video include a dairy land-use baseline/comparison, given the extracted table has no DAIRY · LAND USE row?
Must the video state all plant water-use values, or is it enough to say they are lower than dairy?

units.claim: For emissions, dairy milk is the baseline at 1.000, while plant-based alternatives are lower: rice and soy at 0.250, oat and almond at 0.180.

basis.note: Initial RICE row; inferred same emissions series as DAIRY · EMISSIONS.
Initial SOY row; inferred emissions series.
Initial OAT row; inferred emissions series.
Initial ALMOND row; inferred emissions series.

accept: Dairy emissions are 1.000, while rice and soy are 0.250 and oat/almond are 0.180.
Plant milks have lower emissions than dairy: rice/soy 25% of dairy, oat/almond 18% of dairy.
Emissions ranking: dairy (1.000) > rice = soy (0.250) > oat = almond (0.180).
units.evidence: Emissions panel shows bars for dairy, rice, soy, oat, almond at 1.000, 0.250, 0.250, 0.180, 0.180 respectively.

units.claim: Among plant-based alternatives, rice and soy have the lowest land use (0.050 each), while oat and almond have higher land use (0.200 each).
accept: Rice and soy use the least land (0.050), while oat and almond use 0.200.
Land use is four times higher for oat/almond than rice/soy (0.200 vs 0.050).
Plant-based land use ranges from 0.050 for rice/soy to 0.200 for oat/almond.
units.evidence: Land-use panel shows bars for rice, soy, oat, almond; rice/soy at 0.050 and oat/almond at 0.200.

units.claim: Dairy water use is the highest at 1.000; all plant alternatives are lower: soy and oat 0.100, rice 0.500, almond 0.670.

basis.note: Highest plant value, still below dairy.

accept: Dairy water use is 1.000; plant alternatives range from 0.100 (soy, oat) to 0.670 (almond).
All plant milks use less water than dairy: soy/oat 0.100, rice 0.500, almond 0.670.
Water use ranking: dairy (1.000) > almond (0.670) > rice (0.500) > soy = oat (0.100).
units.evidence: Water-use panel shows bars for dairy, rice, soy, oat, almond at 1.000, 0.500, 0.100, 0.100, 0.670 respectively.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
